name: sameem-hub-production
description: Sameem Hub — Netlify monorepo. Next.js landing + dashboard at /dashboard + Express/Prisma sync API at /api.
//deps: These live at the ROOT on purpose. netlify/functions/api.ts sits at the repo root, so esbuild resolves its imports against root node_modules — not backend/node_modules. @prisma/client is also marked external in netlify.toml, meaning it is NOT bundled and must physically exist in the Lambda's node_modules at runtime.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.netlify:build: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run prisma:generate:root && npm --prefix backend install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend run build
